Callout.Name: Stolen Agricultural Vehicle
Callout.Message: Tractor reported taken from a farm overnight.
Callout.Advisory: Tracks lead towards the highway, no suspect seen.

Script.Line: You cannot hide a tractor. That is what I do not understand.
It went out of the gate and turned left. That is what the tracks say.
It has a tracker on it. Somebody could find it if they wanted.

Lines.Approach: It cannot have gone far at that speed. Tracks head for the highway.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
